facts.text: Villa Sant'Andrea was originally built in 1919 as an escape for an aristocratic family.
facts.excerpt: Originally built in 1919, it was an escape for an aristocratic family who sought to savour the Sicilian coast and the lush subtropical gardens that surrounded the estate.

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since the 1950s.
facts.excerpt: Step into a warm and elegant Sicilian home that has been enchanting guests since the 1950’s.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated outdoor infinity pool.
Lido Villeggiatura is the beach club of Villa Sant'Andrea.
facts.excerpt: Lido Villeggiatura, A Villa Sant’Andrea Beach Club

facts.text: The hotel offers watersports and boat tours.
The hotel offers a complimentary 90-minute group boat tour.
A complimentary shuttle runs to Grand Hotel Timeo in the town centre.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary shuttle to Grand Hotel Timeo, in the town centre

facts.text: The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Catania Airport.
Brizza offers elevated water's edge dining.
facts.excerpt: Elevated water’s edge dining at Brizza

facts.text: Ristorante Sant'Andrea serves relaxed Sicilian seafood.
facts.excerpt: Relaxed Sicilian seafood at Ristorante Sant’Andrea

facts.text: Brace offers a coastal grill experience.
Gwendoline's Bar is an indoor mid-century modern bar.
Smile Club is offered for kids aged 4-12.

facts.excerpt: Discover a menu of indulgent face and body treatments inspired by the beauty of the sea.

facts.text: Experiences from the hotel include volcanic vineyards and coastal exploration.
facts.excerpt: From volcanic vineyards to coastal exploration, set off from Villa Sant’Andrea and find a world of Sicilian adventure.

facts.text: The hotel hosts intimate ceremonial weddings and blessings.
